title: Analyzers for a hospital laboratory
heading: Each Extra Resource Is One More Capacity Row
cases: a set of analyzers within the electrical supply is allowed, and one over it is refused however large the budget
a set whose prices plus the lease it needs fit the budget is allowed, and the same set with a smaller budget is refused
a set needing more leased floor than the adjoining unit offers is refused
a set needing half a square metre of leased floor pays for half a square metre, not a whole one
